name: Pink Elephants 2 - Reborn
review:
The pink elephant sequel on six reels with 4,096 ways. A mystery scatter unlocks a bonus with free spins, symbol transformations and retriggers, and there's a feature buy if you don't want to wait.

The transformations are what make the bonus: turning low symbols into premiums across 4,096 ways adds up fast. High volatility, 10,000x cap, 96.13% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
